independent_evidence.impact_summary: On impact, the residual comparison surface moves by -48.62, the strict loan-core minimum moves by -10.53, the strict non-Treasury securities add-on moves by 11.94, the strict identifiable total moves by -2.19, the remaining residual gap is -46.43.
note_lines: Independent evidence here means direct source-side non-Treasury bank-asset support, not residual closure.
The strict loan-core minimum is the narrow direct core; the strict identifiable total adds a separate direct securities leg.
The remaining gap stays nonzero by design because the strict lane does not try to close the whole non-TDC residual.
independent_evidence.subtitle: EA-TDC no longer treats residual closure as an independent measurement lane; the valid comparison is the narrower `tdcpass` strict source-side block.
independent_evidence.summary: This block imports the stricter `tdcpass` comparison surface built from direct non-Treasury bank-asset transactions. It is intentionally narrower than the full non-TDC residual, so it should be read as independent source-side support rather than as a closure-by-construction total.
independent_evidence.title: Strict independent non-TDC evidence is narrower and source-side

insights.body: The baseline reduced-form work asks whether Treasury Deposit Contribution produces an early, robust deposit response in the selected public quarterly specification.
insights.title: Where does Treasury financing show up first?

insights.body: The main perimeter check asks whether the deposit result survives when the TDC construction broadens from the baseline bank-focused measure to a broader depository-holder definition.
insights.title: Does the deposit result survive broader holder definitions?

insights.body: The boundary check uses the narrower `tdcpass` strict source-side lane rather than residual closure, so independent evidence is limited to directly identifiable non-Treasury bank-asset support.
insights.title: What survives under strict independent non-TDC measurement?

baseline_tdc_lp_credit_spreads.branch_note: Displayed robustness branch uses K=100 screened lagged indicators compressed into factor controls; the macro-core LP remains the transparent baseline.
baseline_tdc_lp_credit_spreads.subtitle: The selected public branch does not support an early credit-spread headline.
baseline_tdc_lp_credit_spreads.summary: Credit measures remain a cross-check, not a lead result. The current public branch does not show a robust early spread response, so this stays in additional evidence.
baseline_tdc_lp_credit_spreads.title: Credit spreads remain secondary evidence

baseline_tdc_lp_deposits.branch_note: Displayed robustness branch uses K=200 screened lagged indicators compressed into factor controls; the macro-core LP remains the transparent baseline.
baseline_tdc_lp_deposits.subtitle: Matched deposits rise on impact while another deposit component leans against them.
baseline_tdc_lp_deposits.summary: The cleanest current transmission result is deposit-side. The baseline TDC estimate raises matched deposits early, but another deposit component moves the other way, which looks more like balance-sheet reallocation than uniform expansion.
baseline_tdc_lp_deposits.title: Deposits reallocate first

baseline_tdc_lp_fx.branch_note: Displayed robustness branch uses K=100 screened lagged indicators compressed into factor controls; the macro-core LP remains the transparent baseline.
baseline_tdc_lp_fx.subtitle: The broad-dollar branch is directional, not decisive.
baseline_tdc_lp_fx.summary: The broad-dollar branch points toward near-term softening, but it is still a one-series supporting check rather than a headline result.
baseline_tdc_lp_fx.title: FX evidence stays modest

baseline_tdc_lp_inflation.branch_note: Displayed robustness branch uses K=100 screened lagged indicators compressed into factor controls; the macro-core LP remains the transparent baseline.
baseline_tdc_lp_inflation.subtitle: Any inflation signal is later and less secure than the deposit result.
baseline_tdc_lp_inflation.summary: Inflation is not part of the headline claim stack. At most, the current branch suggests a later and mixed pattern, with somewhat more movement in core measures than in headline CPI.
baseline_tdc_lp_inflation.title: Inflation remains a secondary branch

baseline_tdc_lp_private_assets.branch_note: Displayed robustness branch uses K=100 screened lagged indicators compressed into factor controls; the macro-core LP remains the transparent baseline.
baseline_tdc_lp_private_assets.subtitle: Category shifts matter more than a single expansion story.
baseline_tdc_lp_private_assets.summary: The private-asset block is a composition check, not a settled mechanism result. It looks across non-Treasury bank securities and lending categories to see where any crowd-out might appear.
baseline_tdc_lp_private_assets.title: Private-asset responses look mixed
